_metadata.name: Sudoers Backdoor for Persistent Privilege Escalation
_metadata.description: Attacker modifies /etc/sudoers and drops a file in /etc/sudoers.d/ to grant passwordless sudo to a compromised account. This provides persistent root access that survives reboots and password changes.

logs._comment: Linux syslog - echo appending NOPASSWD entry to /etc/sudoers
